minor.issue: iter75 test_reset_data_deletes_scoped_preserves_plaid_and_user returned 429 on the very first call of the new session. Root cause: rate-limit 5/hour is applied per-IP via slowapi's default key, and this preview environment shares an egress IP across all recent test runs — so consecutive re-runs within the same hour will contaminate each other. Not a code regression; the endpoint code + limiter are correct.

ui_bugs.component: SettingsScreen — Reset app data row labeling
ui_bugs.issue: The review request said the row should be labeled 'Reset app data' and live under a 'Danger Zone' section. In the actual UI (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx:5413-5416) the row exists and is functional (testID=`settings-reset`, opens ResetAppDataModal), but (a) it is labeled 'Reset App Data' (title-case), and (b) there is no visible 'Danger Zone' header — the row is just placed as a standalone gold-bordered Pressable directly above 'Log Out'. Functionally correct; verbiage differs from the spec.

action_items: LOW — Consider adding an explicit 'Danger Zone' section header (or grouping) above the Reset App Data + Log Out pressables in SettingsScreen (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx:5413-5420) if the product spec mandates it. Also decide whether to keep the label 'Reset App Data' (current) or use 'Reset app data' (as referenced in the review request).

LOW — Rate-limit test flakiness: /api/user/reset-data uses slowapi's default per-IP key. In shared-egress environments (like this preview), that bucket is exhausted across test runs. Recommend switching this route's key_func to `lambda r: (r.state.user or {}).get('user_id') or get_remote_address(r)` so tests running as different registered users each get their own 5/hour bucket. Purely a testability/DX improvement; production impact is nil for real users (who are single-user per IP).

rca_of_issue: Iter75 TDZ RCA update: main agent's swap of the useCallback declaration order in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is EFFECTIVE. `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` (previously line ~6382) is now declared before `legacyPerMonthNet` (previously line ~6363), so when the wrapping useCallback is created during MainApp render, the identifier is already initialised. Verified by (a) clean console during login + Home render, (b) full Legacy screen renders including Projected Investments $0 card / retirement projection ($0 at 7% return) / cumulative growth timeline — none of which would be reachable if the wrapper still crashed. Backend rate-limit RCA: slowapi's default `get_remote_address` keys the 5/hour bucket by request IP. In this preview environment all test agents originate from the same egress IP, so the bucket carries over between runs. Mitigation: either wait ~60m or switch the route to a user-scoped key_func.
